title: Copy All Diagnostics
summary: Puts every lint finding for the current unit onto the clipboard, starting from the Structure form

help: [--db <index.sqlite>]  (a store enables the type-aware and ancestry checks)
[--project-rules]  (also run doc-drift/missing-doc for this file -- OFF by default:
they rebuild facts PER DECL, ~16ms each, and can exceed the IDE's 8s budget)
for editor buffers snapshotted to a temp file -- fixes store membership, file id,
DRY RUN WITHOUT --apply: it reports what it would change and writes no source file.
--fix-line + --fix-rule together narrow the fix to ONE finding; omit both to
apply every fixable finding in the file. Only rules whose catalog entry has
"fixable": true are ever applied -- see `drag-lint rules --json`.
--fix-naming: consent, in a batch run, to the opt-in naming fixes (renames across
every owning project) without listing them in "autofix" in drag-lint-lint.json;
it also prints "rename-local: <N>" (stderr) for the single-project renames.
This is what the IDE Structure form's right-click Fix it / Fix all in unit run.
